messages:
Ava (People Ops): FYI — we're rolling out an updated Code of Conduct and a short compliance module 'Data Handling & Conduct' that everyone must complete by `2025-12-05`.
Priya (Eng): thanks — is this for full-time only or contractors too?
Ava (People Ops): all active employees + contractors on payroll and external hires in onboarding. Contractors get a slightly different checklist in the LMS.
Jamal (Legal): approved wording attached — added clarification around customer PII handling. See doc: https://redwood.example.com/policies/code-of-conduct-v2
Miguel (HR Ops): I'm exporting completion reports nightly to the tracker.
Nora (Hiring Ops): heads-up — please don't mark candidates as hired until training flagged complete for new hires? we need baseline in first-week checklist.
Ava (People Ops): Nora — correct. For offers with start date after `2025-12-01` we include training link in offer packet. Onboarding owners, add it to day 1 tasks.
Priya (Eng): what's the estimated time to complete the module?
Ava (People Ops): ~20 minutes video + 5 minute quiz.
Priya (Eng): ok cool :+1:
Miguel (HR Ops): Tracker (read-only): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xy_ExampleTracker/edit
Miguel (HR Ops): If you manage a team, please update the 'Manager notes' column with exceptions (vacation, LOA, etc.).
ComplianceBot: Reminder sent to everyone who hasn't started the module (message ID 1287)
Ava (People Ops): Managers, please follow up with direct reports who are noncompliant by `2025-12-10`. I'll run a compliance export on `2025-12-11` and share company-wide stats.
Jamal (Legal): If you need accommodation language, DM me — we'll add to the tracker.
Nora (Hiring Ops): Noted — I'll add onboarding checklist PR to the Hiring Ops repo.
Priya (Eng): quick Q — does this count toward performance goals? (asking for PM)
Ava (People Ops): Not a perf goal — it's a mandated compliance item. We'll surface completion in manager dashboards.
Miguel (HR Ops): Any timezone concerns? deadlines will be enforced in UTC.
Ava (People Ops): good call — deadline `2025-12-05T23:59:59Z` UTC.
Priya (Eng): Thanks all.
Ava (People Ops): Closing loop — follow-up summary will be posted in #people-ops and in the handbook update page by EOD tomorrow.
